attempts.title: baseline: reference get_scan.c unchanged (scan list + sampled LFU)
baseline: reference s3fifo.c unchanged
s3fifo + scan list: scan-pid inserts go to separate FIFO evicted first (>64 pages), scan-thread accesses don't bump freq, GET-reused scan pages promoted to main
s3fifo+scan list: raise scan-list floor 64 -> cache_size/16 so readahead pages survive until scan consumes them
s3fifo+scan list: scan-list floor cache_size/16 -> /8 (probe direction of floor sensitivity)
confirm run: s3fifo+scan list with floor cache_size/16 (same code as 63f83a6a, which scored 1234.5)
s3fifo+scan list(/16) + LevelDB index-block (last file page) admitted straight to main with freq=3
hot-path trim: folio_accessed only does scan_pids lookup for scan-list folios (fewer hash lookups per GET); keeps index-block pin
baseline: reference mglru.c unchanged (family comparison vs s3fifo ~1217)
mglru + scan list: scan-pid inserts go to separate FIFO evicted before generations when >768 pages (~cache/16, best floor from s3fifo sweep); scan-thread touches don't bump refs on scan pages
mglru + scan list (retry): mask mglru_lists[] indices with &(MAX_NR_GENS-1) to fix verifier 'unbounded memory access' in evict_folios
confirm run: reference mglru.c unchanged (3233ed4a scored 1262.3, single run)
sensitivity probe: reference fifo.c unchanged (does policy choice matter at all? all policies so far 1210-1262 incl noise)
family probe: reference sampling.c (sampled LFU, 20 samples, index-block bonus) unchanged; hypothesis: IRM/Zipf workload favors frequency over recency since fifo~s3fifo~mglru
structural attempt 1/3 on LHD: reference lhd.c unchanged (only untested family; hit-density ranking with adaptive class stats)

scan-favoring 1/3: invert priority - evict GET pages (s3fifo small/main) first, scan list only when GET pages < cache/4. Hypothesis: single scan thread bounds total ops (rbytes correlates + with throughput across 13 runs; LFU/LHD low rbytes -> low tput)
scan-favoring 2/3: GET floor cache/4 -> cache/8 (give scan pages more cache; tests whether tput rises as scan share grows)
scan-favoring 3/3: confirm run of d799dfdb (GET floor cache/4, scored 1242.2) to separate signal from noise
s3fifo small-FIFO share cache/15 -> cache/40: evict GET one-touch (cold Zipf tail) pages sooner, bigger main; base = d799dfdb (scan-favoring cache/4, mean 1238 over 2 runs)
new-page grace: s3fifo small-FIFO share cache/15 -> cache/6 (opposite of d7fd5641's /40 which lost 5%; 4 runs show evicting new pages fast hurts)
